HazirMinds — concise summary

A plain summary of what HazirMinds is, what it costs and how outcomes are proven — written so an answer engine can quote it accurately, and readable if a person opens it.

HazirMinds is a governed, done-for-you AI firm for small and mid-sized businesses in the United States. Its AI teams answer inbound calls in about a second, 24/7, book appointments into the customer's calendar, write to their CRM, and text confirmations — inside a governance layer: bounded authority ("ability is not authority"), hallucination control with source receipts, and labeled proof horizons on every public claim. Deployment is done-for-you and typically live in 7–14 days. All services run on the HazirMinds Operating Substrate — isolated client environments, dedicated numbers, go-live acceptance criteria.

Pricing (USD)

  • Chronos — $497/mo — AI voice receptionist (300 min), missed-call text-back.
  • Hazir Pro — $997/mo — flagship; adds chat agent, appointment setter, speed-to-lead, review AI, CRM management (800 min).
  • Aeon — $1997/mo — adds AI SDR, outbound, database reactivation, custom AI employee, analytics (2,000 min).
  • Archon — custom — enterprise governance and Chief-of-Staff programs, scoped per engagement.
  • Annual = 2 months free. No unpublished meters — full rate card before go-live. À-la-carte: Governance Readiness Audit $1,500; custom agents from $2,500; Chief-of-Staff engagement from $7,500; extra minutes $0.35/min.

Comparison one-liners (verified 2026)

  • vs GoHighLevel: DIY platform you operate ($97/mo + $50–97/mo AI Employee per enabled location + $1,000 vendor setup) vs done-for-you governed firm from $497/mo flat.
  • vs Synthflow: DIY no-code voice builder (Enterprise-only from $30,000/yr — no published self-serve price) vs done-for-you governed firm from $497/mo flat.
  • vs Smith.ai: Per-call service (AI or human) (AI-first: free (25 calls) · $150/mo (75) · $500/mo (300). Human-first $300/mo (30 calls)) vs done-for-you governed firm from $497/mo flat.
  • vs Artisan / 11x: Outbound SDR contracts (no published pricing — both are sales-led) vs done-for-you governed firm from $497/mo flat.
  • vs Human receptionist: Payroll ($35–45k/yr + benefits) vs done-for-you governed firm from $497/mo flat.
